scientific_question: Can the frozen promoted flip-TTA LayerCAM selector exploit useful BiomedCLIP proposals when the two component/SAM galleries are appended unconditionally rather than replacing or blending LayerCAM?

baseline_lock.method: promoted binary LayerCAM plus horizontal-flip TTA

single_changed_variable.operation: Append the exact frozen BiomedCLIP percentile-component/SAM proposal gallery after the exact promoted LayerCAM gallery for every image-level-positive validation image.

execution_order: Verify exact source, split, checkpoints and all 371 physical saliency-map hashes without segmentation GT
Run focused tests including proposal-gallery source ordering and cap
Generate all 371 pseudo masks and 184 complete candidate diagnostics without segmentation GT
Freeze pseudo-mask and candidate-diagnostic manifest hashes
Only then load validation GT in a separate evaluator
Compare against the frozen promoted baseline with 10000-iteration paired complete-group bootstrap overall and for all fixed subgroups

promotion_gates.continue_selector_research: unconditional union raw-oracle delta CI95 lower bound > 0 overall and in each subgroup
promotion_gates.direct_train_pseudo_mask_generation: overall final-Dice paired CI95 lower bound > 0 and final mean Dice does not decrease in any of small, medium or large
promotion_gates.interpretation: Oracle success permits selector research only. Train pseudo masks remain unauthorized unless the final-Dice gate passes.

forbidden: validation segmentation GT before both prediction manifests are hash-frozen
test images, labels, predictions or metrics
GT-oracle candidate selection or per-image source routing
post-hoc threshold, selector, support, morphology or prompt tuning
dropping complete misses or changing the cohort, split, group IDs or metric
